text:
jess: quick handoff — prepping v1.8.0-rc1. Cutoff in ~2h. Need someone to create the annotated tag (signed if possible), upload linux/mac binaries from the build artifacts, and paste sha256 sums into the GH draft. I can tidy the CHANGELOG after tags are pinned.
matt: I can do the tag + upload. Confirm tag format? using `v1.8.0-rc1` (no build metadata) and annotated+signed? also do you want the tag pushed to origin or only draft release created first?
sophia: annotated + GPG-signed tag please. Release key is in vault under `release/signing-key` — use `git tag -s -m "v1.8.0-rc1" v1.8.0-rc1` then `git push origin v1.8.0-rc1`.
samir: note the CI job `release/build-and-store` uploads artifacts to s3 at `s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0-rc1/`. If you upload GitHub release assets, please take them from that bucket to avoid rebuilds.
matt: thanks, will pull from s3. Will run checksum script and attach `sha256sums.txt` to the release. Example we use:
```bash
sha256sum redwood-linux-amd64.tar.gz > sha256sums.txt
sha256sum redwood-darwin-amd64.tar.gz >> sha256sums.txt
cat sha256sums.txt
```
sophia: when you create the draft release please put the short changelog bullets in the body and include a `Checksums` section with the file contents. Also add the `rc` prerelease flag.
matt: ack. One question: should we also pin the binary checksums in the release notes and add `artifact:sha256:<hex>` metadata in the release description? we did that last release and it helped QA.
jess: yes, please add `artifact:sha256:<hex>` lines for each file. QA will rely on that for automated verification. Also include the commit sha used to build.
matt: working on it now. tagging command I plan to run:
```bash
git fetch --tags origin
git checkout main
git pull
git tag -s v1.8.0-rc1 -m "v1.8.0-rc1"
git push origin v1.8.0-rc1
```
sophia: after pushing the tag I'll create the GH draft at `https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/releases/new` and mark as prerelease. ping me once assets are uploaded so I can attach them and paste the checksums.
matt: pushed tag and started uploads. Upload job shows progress, should finish in ~4m. attaching sha file to draft now.
release-bot: release/upload-artifacts succeeded for build 4852 (s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0-rc1/). :white_check_mark:
sophia: draft created and assets attached. Draft URL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v1.8.0-rc1
samir: quick reminder — cutoff branch `release/v1.8.x` is locked for merges except for critical fixes. If anyone needs to patch, open PR against that branch and tag it `release:patch`.
jess: thanks team — I will finish the changelog small edits and merge the final doc into the draft before cutoff. If anything blocks tagging or upload, @matt @sophia ping me here. :thumbsup:
